1.explanation: The List component’s getPictureCardList method checks for a user-provided itemRender function and, if present, replaces the entire thumbnail/overlay area with the custom rendering. That branch never injects the default delete (closable) Icon nor wires up handleClose, so the close button is never shown. The Card component simply passes itemRender down to List. To fix it, getPictureCardList must merge the default close icon (and actionRender) into or alongside the custom itemRender output so that handleClose can still be triggered.
1.bug_scenario: In the Upload component when using a custom itemRender (e.g. to overlay a timer on an image), the default delete (close) button is not rendered. As a result, users cannot remove uploaded items via the UI even though onRemove and handleClose are implemented internally.

2.bug_scenario: The report shows that when using the Upload component in “card” mode together with a custom itemRender, the delete (close/ashbin) icon no longer appears. In the screenshot the last image item has been rendered via the user’s itemRender function (showing an overlay with “06:08”) but the built-in delete control is missing and clicking cannot remove the file.
